annotations.title: Audit DCSA Facility Clearance (FCL), DD Form 254 & FOCI Mitigation

description: Audit DD Form 254 Contract Security Classification Specifications (Blocks 10, 11, 13), Standard Form 328 (SF 328 — Certificate Pertaining to Foreign Interests), and corporate cap-table / foreign investor structures against 32 CFR Part 117 (NISPOM) and Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency (DCSA) Facility Clearance (FCL) and Foreign Ownership, Control, or Influence (FOCI) mitigation standards, returning an FCL & FOCI executive overview, a DD Form 254 Block 10/11 safeguarding matrix (COMSEC, SCI, SIPRNet, CUI), an SF 328 foreign interest factor audit, a DCSA FOCI mitigation agreement blueprint (Board Resolution, SCA, SSA with NID, or Proxy/Voting Trust with ECP and TCP controls), and a Key Management Personnel (KMP) Exclusion Resolution & NISP eMASS checklist. This is a read-only, stateless, non-destructive industrial security audit call (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; `dd254_and_ownership_cap_table_text` accepts 20 to 45,000 characters, while `target_facility_clearance_level` and `foreign_ownership_and_board_context` calibrate DCSA FCL safeguarding and 32 CFR 117.11 FOCI mitigation instruments). Use this tool when auditing DD Form 254 classified safeguarding requirements, SF 328 foreign ownership/LP triggers, or DCSA FCL / FOCI mitigation agreements; use `generate_ato_rmf_package` instead for DoD RMF / Continuous ATO (cATO) NIST 800-53 System Security Plans, or `match_key_personnel` for individual candidate security clearance and LCAT resume verification.

dd254_and_ownership_cap_table_text.description: DD Form 254 Contract Security Classification Specification text (Blocks 10, 11, 13), SF 328 Certificate Pertaining to Foreign Interests entries, and corporate cap-table / foreign investor ownership structure (20 to 45,000 characters).

foreign_ownership_and_board_context.description: Summary of foreign equity voting/ownership percentages, foreign board seats, foreign debt, or foreign technology licensing ties under 32 CFR Part 117 (NISPOM; defaults to 'Minority_Foreign_LP_Or_Board_Seat_Under_Review').

target_facility_clearance_level.description: Required Facility Clearance (FCL) and safeguarding posture (e.g., Confidential, Secret, Top Secret, TS/SCI, COMSEC, SIPRNet, JWICS; defaults to 'Top_Secret_FCL_With_SCI_And_SIPRNet').

name: audit_foci_dd254_clearance

dcsa_foci_mitigation_agreement_blueprint.description: Structured DCSA FOCI mitigation blueprint (Board Resolution, SCA, SSA, or Proxy/Voting Trust) with Outside Director, ECP, and TCP controls.

dd254_block10_and_11_safeguarding_matrix.description: Block-by-block audit of DD Form 254 Block 10, 11, and 13 classified access, safeguarding, COMSEC, SCI, and SIPRNet mandates.

fcl_and_foci_executive_overview.description: High-level DCSA Facility Clearance (FCL) eligibility verdict, FOCI severity tier, and recommended mitigation instrument.

kmp_exclusion_resolution_and_nisp_emass_.description: Step-by-step Key Management Personnel (KMP) List, Board Exclusion Resolution, DISS, and NISP eMASS submission checklist.

sf328_foreign_interest_factor_audit.description: Evaluation of Standard Form 328 (Certificate Pertaining to Foreign Interests) triggers across foreign equity, LP feeders, board seats, debt, and revenue.

title: Audit DCSA Facility Clearance (FCL), DD Form 254 & FOCI Mitigation
